Newline
Retrieve the latest queued input for editing

Interrupt the current provider or tool operation; after rebuilding the interrupted session, submit the captured FIFO head once — only if it is still the queue head — or just interrupt when the queue is empty
Open the rewind picker
Save the draft and clear it, without sending
Paste a clipboard image (only vision-capable models receive it; terminal text paste still inserts text normally)
Re-run the last turn as a new candidate (the old one is kept); in Workspace, `Ctrl+R` keeps its file-reload meaning
Switch between the current turn's candidates
Open the candidate-tree panel to browse and switch candidate branches at any depth (both pages)
Move the turn-focus cursor across the whole transcript (wraps); the focused turn's prompt and final reply are highlighted
Exit Vesicle
Move focus between the options
Expands the focused confirm option's note input on stop-gate and engine-switch prompts; permission prompts carry notes only on Reject (always-on input). Esc clears the note and returns to the options
Submit the focused option; a typed note is submitted with the decision (permission Allow takes no note)
Read the dialog or selected item's details
Clear the note and move focus to Reject
Scroll details line by line; the position indicator shows the visible range
Scroll expanded details; the reading position is shared with the arrow keys
Jump to the top / bottom
Return to the options without submitting, rejecting or clearing a note
Quick open: subsequence fuzzy match across project files; Enter opens, Esc closes
Move the selection
Expand a directory, or open a file and hand focus to the viewer/editor
Collapse a directory or move to the parent
Create a file (path input bar; `a/b/c.md` works, parents are created; an existing target is refused, not overwritten)
Create a directory
Move / rename (input bar prefills the directory prefix; type the new name; an existing target opens an overwrite confirm)
Copy (same rules as `m`)
Delete: `y` deletes (moves to the `.vesicle/trash/` recycle bin); any other key cancels; directories only when empty; unsaved edits are noted in the confirm

Validate the **selection**: a selected file validates and opens findings; a directory or empty selection shows `select a file to validate`; a file with unsaved edits shows `save <path> before validating`
Validate the open file and open findings (labelled `v findings` when a current result exists)
Alias for the arrow keys (inert while a text input is active)
Alias for Esc — step focus back one level
Refresh the directory; (read-only viewer) re-read the file
Show/hide dotfiles and noisy directories (`.git`, `node_modules`, `dist`, …)
Scroll
Toggle preview and source: an editable Markdown shows `m edit`; a read-only/oversized/truncated Markdown shows `m source` (read-only source) or `m preview`; a metadata-only symlink offers no toggle
Save (atomic write, project-root-bounded, rejects `..` and absolute paths); re-runs validation on save
Save as (type a new path)
Undo / redo
Find: locate as you type, Enter next, Shift+Enter previous, Esc close
Go to line (type a line number)
Reload the on-disk version (confirms if there are local edits or the disk changed)
Insert two spaces of indentation
With unsaved edits: "save / discard / cancel"; otherwise step back one level
Close the overlay and return to the main surface
Cancel only the side request and close, leaving the main turn running
Scroll the current answer
Move between this session's side exchanges
Copy the current answer's raw Markdown
Clear all of this session's side exchanges and close
Copy selected text and clear selection; without a selection, a second press within 3000ms exits.
Dismiss splash and consume the key without editing composer or choosing a panel option.

keyboardContexts.behavior: Toggle pages ahead of bottom-modal or reading capture; preserve pending decision and reader state.

keyboardContexts.context: Chat artifact sidebar visible and nonempty
keyboardContexts.behavior: Enter artifact focus, select, open the focused artifact, or leave focus; full relative path remains visible.
Cycle tree/viewer/composer, skipping viewer when no file is open.
Select and complete slash command or guarded argument without also scrolling transcript; Esc clears the composer; Enter submits when the selected input is already complete.
Move/edit by composer semantics; wrapped rows own Up/Down before history; modified arrows do not leak to the transcript.
Distinct Shift+Enter is inert; trailing backslash+Enter inserts a newline.
Select findings; Enter jumps only for an editable target; Esc closes without an edit.
Dialog owns editing and confirmation; typed letters do not invoke tree file operations.

keyboardContexts.context: Workspace tree/viewer/editor/composer with an open file
keyboardContexts.behavior: Suspend the TUI for external editor handoff, refusing unsaved buffers; resume and refresh/validate on return.

precedence: Active bottom surface (decisions suppressed on Workspace; pickers/confirms remain modal)
Workspace/controller, artifact focus, Stage/candidate interaction and composer according to current focus
queueContract: Immediate host actions do not split an active provider tool round.
after-tool-round inputs are consumed before the next provider request; after-agent-loop commands wait for the loop.
Opening a picker pauses queue drain; session switch/reset clears the queue.
Workspace pending decision strip keeps focus in workspace and preserves composer draft; Enter neither sends nor queues until answered.
limitations: These are context-qualified preservation requirements, not proof of native terminal event reporting. Native CJK/IME/clipboard/editor observations remain distinct lanes.
src/tui/keymap.ts is an unused legacy two-string stub; actual routing is input-routing.ts and the focused controllers.
